checks.name: QA GATE 04 — SOLAR CLAIM
checks.findings: The critical solar physics overstatement has been completely eliminated. Spoken voiceover is scientifically qualified to 'In a dawn-dusk orbit, panels can capture up to eight times more solar energy annually than on Earth.' Visual Direction §2.5 replaces permanent 100% illumination with near-continuous illumination along the dawn-dusk terminator, subject to seasonal eclipse periods. The primary card 'UP TO 8× ANNUAL SOLAR HARVEST' (5 words) and separate secondary label 'ANNUAL CUMULATIVE ENERGY HARVEST (not solar-cell efficiency)' eliminate any viewer confusion regarding photovoltaic cell efficiency.
checks.evidence: Zero occurrences of 'constant orbital sunlight' and 'Continuous 100% direct solar illumination' confirmed by global workspace search. Storyboard Shot 04 diagrams and prompts accurately represent high sunlight availability without physical 8x bar distortions.
checks.notes: PASS: Fully compliant with astronomical and orbital solar thermodynamics.

checks.name: QA GATE 05 — THERMAL PHYSICS
checks.findings: Thermal dissipation in vacuum is modeled with scientific precision. Zero convective cooling fans are depicted or referenced. The heat path is strictly conductive (TPU dies bonded to sealed copper heat pipes) followed by radiative cooling (dual high-emissivity carbon-nanotube external planar radiators facing deep space). The 15-minute burst duty cycle is clearly explained and visually diagrammed.
checks.evidence: Storyboard SATELLITE_MASTER_DESIGN §4: 'STRICTLY PASSIVE VACUUM THERMODYNAMICS (NO FANS / ZERO CONVECTION)'. Shot 05 diagram: 'CONVECTIVE AIRFLOW: 0.0 W/m²K (VACUUM VOID)', fan icon with bold red diagonal strikeout '[NO CONVECTIVE FANS]'. Shot 07 diagram: 'TPU DIES -> COPPER HEAT PIPES -> RADIATOR FINS -> IR RADIATION TO DEEP SPACE', 'DUTY CYCLE: 15-MIN BURSTS'. Negative prompts explicitly forbid cooling fans and smoke.
checks.notes: PASS: Flawless vacuum thermodynamic modeling and burst duty cycle integration.

checks.name: QA GATE 06 — RADIATION
checks.findings: Semiconductor radiation effects are accurately depicted as single-event upsets (SEUs) and memory bit-flips (0 -> 1) caused by high-energy cosmic protons penetrating High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) capacitors, grounded in UC Davis Crocker Nuclear Laboratory cyclotron test results. Zero fictional explosions, melts, or comic-book disintegration effects are present.
checks.evidence: Script Shot 5 voiceover: 'and space radiation triggers memory bit-flips.' Storyboard Shot 06: 'Particle trajectory: HIGH-ENERGY PROTON (CYCLOTRON SIMULATED), target: HBM CELL [0x4F8A], DATA STATE: 0 -> 1 [SINGLE-EVENT UPSET], sub-badge: UC DAVIS CROCKER NUCLEAR LAB'. Negative prompt: 'giant explosions, shattered chips, burning flames, comic book radiation symbols, neon gore'.
checks.notes: PASS: Accurate representation of Single-Event Upsets without Hollywood hyperbole.
